reviews.text: Staff is courteous, doctors take the time to explain whatever is going on with my doggie. I’m very protective of him so I always watch to see how he’s being treated. I can say they have been good with him. I am pleased with their service.
Good place
A very complete clinic for our pets who are part of the family.
We love our Vets at Cy-Fair.  They are always there for us.
Always a  great experience!  We actually saw Dr. Blue this time!  He treated my baby real good 👍 they all take care of my Ceasar!

I've always rec'd very competant and compassionate care from the staff at this location.  I'm the president of the HOA located behind the vet clinic. I talk with a lot of people here who use this same clinic.  Same response - great staff that provides great interaction with the people and their pets.
Caring staff with reasonable pricing, definitely recommend.
I love all the crew, they are so kind and informative when Im in a panic over one of my fur babies.
The staff is great and dr levigne is great vet .I really like him
I've been coming here for years all the way back to when it was Dr Anthony Briles. Now I trust Dr Levigne with my pet's care and he is great.

You guys took care of my cat and child as if they were yours and for that I think thank you many times over.
This is the only place I’m comfortable bringing my pets.

We've been bringing our dogs here since 2024, and I truly can't say enough wonderful things about this veterinary team. From routine visits to one of the hardest days of our lives when we had to say goodbye to a beloved dog, they have treated us with incredible compassion, kindness, and respect. They never make you feel like just another client—they make you feel like family.
Today, they performed an emergency C-section on our miniature poodle, Tia. It was a very scary experience, but they took amazing care of her and her puppies. Thanks to their skill, quick action, and dedication, Tia and her babies are doing well, and we couldn't be more grateful.
Every veterinarian, technician, and staff member genuinely cares about both the pets and the people who love them. They take the time to answer questions, explain everything, and provide comfort during both happy and heartbreaking moments.
I wish Google allowed more than 5 stars because they truly deserve 10. Thank you for everything you've done for our family. We will always trust you with our pets.

I knew my senior dog, Lady, was in the most capable hands, even when the surgery was more complex than anticipated. The staff are all wonderful and kind, communicated about everything I needed to know, and Dr. Blue answered all questions and was clear about everything. I knew there wasn't a better place to have Lady taken care of, and I'm so thankful for the care everyone provided. And because of Dr. Blue, we won't have to see another specialist. The compassion they have for animals really shines through - and it settled this dog mom's heart knowing she was so well taken care of in the best hands.

This is a happy story as result of CyFair Animal clinic’s help. I brought in a severely matted and skinny lost dog to their clinic to scan for chip. Fortunately, the dog is chipped. They help call the microchip  company and got the owners information. Equipped with all the information, I drove the dog to the address and we were able to reunite the dog and the owner. The dog was lost for 7 months! What a survivor. Thank you CyFair for your help and support.
They take care of my furbabies as if they were their own. Love everyone working there, from the ladies running the office to the vets and their techs!
Great environment. Welcoming staff.

If your animal needs help, this is the place to take it. The techs are very knowledgeable, patient, and ready to help. The docs really have your animal's best interest at heart. I've taken all of my animals to them, for several years. I haven't had a single bad experience.

The front desk misleads claiming that the requested services are provided in this location while in fact they are not. The appointment fee was given incorrectly over the phone, it appeared to be different in person. I was referred to a Gulf Coast which runs its business on a high end cost( I was there once and it was all about everything but not the cause of my visit with the cost of a car but nowhere near to the point). The personnel ( Dr. Ross)  of a Cy-Fair Animal Aldine location looks very trusted and knowledgeable but apparently waist of my time. I would not recommend the place.
PS: came for an exotic visit( rabbit)

I've been here several times with some of my dogs. I have 7. Usually I felt the cost for the service provided was fair. Yesterday I brought my 6lb. Chihuahua in to be put down. I was there 35 minutes. I saw Dr. Ross for 3 minutes. My bill came to $175.  In addition if you want the animal cremated it's another $75 to the crematory. It's upsetting enough to put my dog down but then, I got screwed by the providers. That won't happen again.
Good service.
Best people caring.
Ive taking 4 of my animals there. They are wonderful ❤️ I recommend them....
Friendly and great customer service.

I came to this place because they were listed as a hospital.

They are not open 24 hrs 😭

They maybe had what I needed but since it wasn't 24hrs. I won't know. 🥲

I'm just hoping I can find the oxygen tanks that I need for my Pet so it may help her breathe better so the medicine may work 🥲

God Bless 🙏

Over priced and poor customer service. After the assistant asked me question she proceeded to go make fun of my answers to the dr. / vet. Their walls are thin so I heard all of their conversation. A stool sample was thrown in the bill and was charged $52 for it, I was told to bring it in later. I was not given a time frame. I finally went to go drop it off and all the employees were gathered around the front desk and paid very little attention to me being there since they were in their own conversation. I called a WEEK later for the results and they had no clue about the results. The person that picked up the phone call, was just blaming everyone else, that she was not there that day, that why I didn't go sooner, that I had to repay for another test, that on that day they were short staffed. I did tell her, short staff? if there was enough time to gather around the front desk and one person was comfortably sitting on the floor participating in the conversation. That hardly seemed of an office that is short staffed. All of this excused to come back with the sample was sent, but the person that should of called me hadn't gotten around to it.  I had to call again a WEEK later, because the person still had not called me back, another person finally gave me the results and told me to come in for some medicine and I requested for the results to be emailed to me, her attitude change, and question why I needed the results, if I was going to look up the medicine. I told her if she needed my email address and she said that she had it. She did not email me the results until I called & emailed again A WEEK LATER.  I am writing this post, because just yesterday , the person that should of called me with the results, finally called. A MONTH LATER.

My experience was exceptional, the front desk was friendly and extremely helpful,  she could tell I was anxious about my puppy's first visit, sorry I am not go with name but think it was Jackie that was at the front desk.  The assistant Pamela was so knowledgeable and answered all of my questions cheerfully.  Dr. Ross was right time, she examined my puppy and we were out the door. This was a lot better experience than I expected.

This vet clinic location was convenient in my neighborhood, once it changed to Cy fair, I particular didn’t experience good service. A week ago I called to just purchase flea topical control for my dog, they wouldn’t sell it because I stopped taken my dog. I went to Petco and got what I needed.
Will take pets again.

Very satisfied and grateful for the service provided. I loved the thoughtful card they sent us after our beloved dog's cremation.

Thank you so much!
Excellent place! The vet and staff were very kind and compassionate, and they gave my very sick dog great care. I am very grateful.
Staff was super attentive, and I felt very knowledgeable 🥰💖 definitely recommend this Hospital for your Furr babies …
I love this VET! BUT ASHLEY AT THE FRONT DESK IS ALWAYS MEAN AND RUDE!
Clean and very good service, all my pets are cared for there.
Took care of “baby”
Very caring staff.

I had a terrible experience during my last visit for my dog’s annual check up. This was my second visit and I had the misfortune of getting Dr. Devaney. I can honestly say she contributed nothing to the visit other than creating unnecessary stress. She did not introduce herself when she came into the room, just went immediately into talking to me in such a demeaning and disrespectful manner. She was treating me like I was child in trouble. I have never been treated like this by a vet. My dog had gained 9lbs since the last vet visit due to his diet and I feel like her poor attempt at trying to educate me was ineffective due to it being lost by how she treated me. If she truly wanted to educate me about her concerns, she would’ve talked to me in a different manner instead of ranting at me. It almost felt like I was being quizzed and if I answered in a way she didn’t like, she got off on belittling me in telling me why I was wrong. I snapped at her and asked her why she was attacking me and acting like I was a terrible owner that abused their pet and her tone changed immediately so I know she could be kind if she tried. It also made me think that if she talked to me in this way and I’m a paying customer then she probably talks like this or worse to the rest of the staff. She truly made it feel like I paid $200+ to get bullied.
The three stars are for the vet tech and the other staff during my visit. They made up for the horrible experience I had with that doctor by being kind and caring. I did have a manager contact me after the visit to hear what happened from me which I did appreciate. It feels as though this was a one off experience with one terrible doctor but I wanted to make this review to make others cautious of that particular doctor and to stand up for yourself if she tries to bully you.

We had a positive experience with the Cy-Fair Animal Hospital vet visit!The registration and check-in were effortless. It's always reassuring when the staff and vet team are attentive and caring. Our pet doing great!
Excellent and professional staff!
All 4 of my dogs have been her and I highly recommend them they are Great with my dogs always on top of everything they need
One of the best and more affordable vets  in Houston. I love their staff, very helpful.
Such friendly staff, they really care about my fur babies. Dr. blue and the tech were very informative and knowledgeable

Picked up my dog from boarding and he has a shoulder wound so awful I’m taking the picture down so the review is actually posted….  No explanation given, it mysteriously happened overnight and he supposedly did it himself, but the vet was really “nice” and put a stitch on it and a cone at no charge…. I was only informed at pick up, despite multiple phone communications happening during the stay for different reasons.
In addition to their cruelty, they lied about how he got wounded to my face. It absolutely looks like a dog fight, they don’t deserve anyone’s trust.
